name: QE Soundboard — Act 2: The Twist
description: Click a sound to play it for everyone.

sounds.name: Whitecastle: the call
sounds.description: [warmly] Hey, good to see you, chummer! [conspiratorial] Listen — I've got a client with deep pockets and a very... public problem. Pays well. Meet's tonight.

sounds.name: Whitecastle: asked for you
sounds.description: [laughs] Funny thing, though. The client asked for your team by name. [beat] Don't ask me how they know you. I didn't tell 'em.

sounds.name: Carrone: let's not waste time
sounds.description: [brusque] Let's not waste each other's time. [crisp] Euphoria is missing. [beat] Again. [measured] MegaMedia wants her back — [pause] and I'm told you're discreet.

sounds.name: Carrone: name your price
sounds.description: [cold, precise] Find her. Quietly. [pause] Before the press does. [beat] [smooth] Name your price... [dry] within reason.

sounds.name: Carrone: I know what you did
sounds.description: [cold, measured] I know exactly who took her the first time. [pause] The only question is whether you're going to be useful to me now.

sounds.name: Carrone: don't disappoint me
sounds.description: [pleasantly] MegaMedia has a long memory — and a very large legal department. [beat] Don't disappoint me.

sounds.name: Read-aloud: the condo
sounds.description: [hushed] The penthouse door is open. Inside, the air is thick with something sharp and chemical... like vinegar left to rot. [pause] The bodyguards are still here. Most of them. [slowly] Whatever did this did not use a gun.

sounds.name: Read-aloud: the sim recording
sounds.description: [softly] The playback takes you behind her eyes. Music. A mirror. A smile she's practiced a thousand times. [pause] Then the glass bursts inward — and something with too many limbs fills the frame. [tense] You feel her scream in your own throat.

sounds.name: Burroughs: nothing to do with me
sounds.description: [defensive, too fast] I-I don't know what you think you've found, but it has nothing to do with me. [nervous laugh] Strice Foods runs a clean operation. [voice rising] A clean operation!

sounds.name: Burroughs: he made me
sounds.description: [voice breaking] You don't understand. He— he has things on me. He said he'd ruin me! [desperate] He said nobody would get hurt...

sounds.name: Burroughs: calling Lone Star
sounds.description: [panicked, shouting] Security! [frantic] Get Lone Star on the line — now! [breathless] There's an intrusion in the system!
